headline: Namdeo Narayan Khamitkar resigns as Independent Director of Ravinder Heights
summary: Ravinder Heights Limited has announced the resignation of Mr. Namdeo Narayan Khamitkar from his position as Non-Executive Independent Director. The resignation is effective from October 03, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing regarding board composition changes at the company. Retail investors should note that board changes at small-cap real estate firms generally have minimal immediate impact on stock prices.
why_it_matters: Routine board changes rarely alter small-cap stock performance.

headline: Ravinder Heights appoints Akansha Gupta as Company Secretary
summary: Ravinder Heights has appointed Akansha Gupta as its new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The routine corporate governance update involves administrative changes within the listed entity. Indian retail investors tracking the company's operational compliance will note the transition.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no immediate financial impact
